sources.entry: ElectronMail - An Electron-based unofficial desktop client for ProtonMail. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/vladimiry/ElectronMail) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]
ElectronMail - Unofficial desktop app for ProtonMail and Tutanota end-to-end encrypted email providers.

summary.one_liner: ElectronMail is an unofficial Electron-based desktop client for ProtonMail, written in TypeScript and Angular, that adds features the official web clients lack.
summary.what_it_does: The app wraps ProtonMail in a desktop window and adds local features such as an encrypted local message store (database.bin) for offline reading, full-text search including body content, and batch export of emails to EML files. It supports multiple accounts with per-account proxy settings and selectable API entry points, including a Tor onion address option. Optional automation includes auto-login with system keychain-stored master password (via keytar), auto-filling of account credentials and 2FA tokens, and persistent email sessions. Other features include a system tray icon showing unread counts, native notifications, calendar alarms, dark mode, batch mail moving and removal, and per-account custom CSS. The README says the prepackaged Proton web clients are built from source and that installation packages are verifiable against source code.
use_cases: export emails to EML or JSON files
manage multiple ProtonMail accounts with per-account proxy
get desktop notifications for new mail
auto-login to email accounts with saved credentials
how_to_run: Run pnpm run electron-builder:dist to build a Windows/macOS package, or a Linux target such as electron-builder:dist:linux:appimage
Find the assembled installation package in the ./dist folder
notable: Reproducible builds with a CI config included, so release packages can be checked against source
Local encrypted database.bin store enables offline viewing and full-text search
Per-account proxy and selectable API entry points, including a Tor version 3 address
Prepackaged Proton web clients built from source
Installable from several package repositories maintained by different contributors
caveats: Unofficial client, not affiliated with ProtonMail
Some features require the local store to be enabled, and attachment content is not stored locally
Building from source needs Node.js v24, native module toolchains, and on Linux libsecret; Snap builds need Snap and LXD
Some package repository builds are marked obsolete or community-maintained
keywords: alternative to official protonmail bridge app
